; forward evolution, c2 in {.01,...,.10}
define list<delay> tau1 = {0.00000455 0.00000465 0.00000475 0.00000485 0.00000495 0.00000505 0.00000515 0.00000525 0.00000535 0.00000545}

"l1=0"  ; start the evolution counter at 0

; forward time evolution, controlled by cnst2 variable
; backward time evolution variable and precompiled
; td2 = max 25, time evo
; td1 = 10, c2 list length


1   ze

2
d1 rpp1 rpp2 rpp3 rpp4
100u pl2:f2

(p1 ph0):f2

; Forward evolution loop
4
tau1
(p1 ph1^):f2
tau2
(p1 ph2^):f2
tau3
(p1 ph3^):f2
tau2
(p1 ph4^):f2
tau1p
(p1 ph1^):f2
tau2
(p1 ph2^):f2
tau3
(p1 ph3^):f2
tau2
(p1 ph4^):f2
tau1

lo to 4 times l1

; make sure when l1=0 we don't mess up control
1.5u
(p1 ph9):f2
1m
(p1 ph30):f2

go=2 ph31
1m wr #0 if #0

iu1
iu1

25m ip9*160

lo to 2 times td2

;reset time evo counter
5m ru1

;reset phase programs
25m rp9

;update time reversal strength
5m tau1.inc
5m tau2.inc
5m tau3.inc
5m tau1p.inc

lo to 2 times td1

exit
